summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Media Library page with DropZone component integration. All UI features working correctly including property folder sidebar, subfolder navigation, DropZone drag-and-drop area, Upload modal, New Folder modal, Grid/List view toggle, and search functionality.
passed_tests: Frontend: Media Library page loads correctly with data-testid='media-library-page'
Frontend: Property folder sidebar displays all properties with addresses and locations
Frontend: Folder expand/collapse works - shows Gallery, Videos, Documents subfolders
Frontend: Subfolder navigation works - clicking Gallery/Videos/Documents updates breadcrumb
Frontend: DropZone component displays in empty folder state with drag-drop area
Frontend: DropZone shows 'Drag & drop files here' text
Frontend: DropZone shows 'browse from device' link
Frontend: DropZone shows 'Max file size: 100 MB' indicator
Frontend: Upload button opens Upload modal with DropZone component
Frontend: Upload modal shows correct destination path (property/subfolder)
Frontend: New Folder button opens Create New Folder modal
Frontend: New Folder modal shows folder name input and correct path
Frontend: Grid/List view toggle buttons work correctly
Frontend: Search files input accepts text
Frontend: Refresh button is clickable
Frontend: Different property selection works - updates main content area
Frontend: Hidden file input exists for file selection
Frontend: File input accepts multiple files
Backend: GET /api/media/folders returns property folders with subfolders
Backend: GET /api/media/folders/{property_id} returns folder contents
Backend: GET /api/media/folders/{property_id}?subfolder=gallery returns subfolder contents
Backend: POST /api/media/upload returns 'iDrive storage not configured' (expected)
critical_code_review_comments: DropZone component is well-implemented with proper drag-and-drop event handling
File validation includes size check with user-friendly error messages
MediaLibraryPage correctly integrates DropZone in both empty state and upload modal
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
iDrive storage integration requires user credentials to function - actual file uploads will fail without configuration
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media Library page with DropZone component is fully functional. The DropZone appears in two places: 1) Empty folder state 2) Upload modal. iDrive storage is NOT configured so actual file uploads will fail with 'iDrive storage not configured' error. Backend endpoints at /api/media/* are working correctly. All UI interactions (folder navigation, modals, view toggle, search) are working.

features_verified.media_library_page: Loads correctly with property folder sidebar
features_verified.dropzone_empty_state: Displays in empty folders with drag-drop area
features_verified.dropzone_upload_modal: Displays in Upload modal with same functionality
features_verified.folder_navigation: Property folders and subfolders (gallery/videos/documents) navigation works
features_verified.upload_modal: Opens correctly with DropZone and shows destination path
features_verified.new_folder_modal: Opens correctly with folder name input

mocked_integrations.iDrive_storage: NOT CONFIGURED - File uploads will fail. Requires iDrive credentials to be configured in Developer Settings.
